say:1:1511429001:0.text: Where did you go? Did you run into a beast?
say:1:1511429001:0.source_cn: 阿米，你刚才去哪了？是遇到野兽了吗？

say:2:1511429002:1.source_cn: 别担心，顿，什么事也没发生。

say:3:1511429003:1.text: I thought I saw a figure in the trees, so I went to check. Turned out it was just my imagination.
say:3:1511429003:1.source_cn: 我只是看到树林里有人影一闪而过，所以才追了上去。幸好，...

say:5:1511429005:1.text: Oh, that. A bird flew right over my head and startled me. For a moment I thought it was an arrow.
say:5:1511429005:1.source_cn: 噢……是一只鸟从我头顶上飞过，把我吓了一跳。它离我那么...

say:6:1511429006:1.text: What's the matter, Dunn? Want to comfort me?
say:6:1511429006:1.source_cn: 怎么，顿，你要安慰我一下吗？

say:10:1511429008:1.text: Can't you tell? He likes her.
say:10:1511429008:1.male: Can't you tell? He likes her.
say:10:1511429008:1.female: Can't you tell? He likes her.

say:11:1511429011:0.text: Well, if nothing happened, let's all get some rest.
say:11:1511429011:0.source_cn: 既然没事了，就早点休息。

say:14:1511429013:0.text: Ames, go to sleep. I'll take the next watch.
say:14:1511429013:0.source_cn: 阿米，你去睡觉吧，后半夜我来替你值守。

say:15:1511429014:1.text: Thank you, Dunn. You're so thoughtful.

say:16:1511429015:1.text: N-no need to thank me... hehe...

narration:17:1511429016:1.text: At Dunn's urging, you all return to the fire and try to sleep.
narration:17:1511429016:1.source_cn: 在顿的催促下，你们回到篝火旁继续休息

narration:18:1511429017:0.text: Maybe it's the exhaustion, but this time you actually drift off...
narration:18:1511429017:0.source_cn: 或许是因为有些疲累，这一次你真的睡着了
narration:18:1511429017:0.male: Maybe it's the exhaustion, but this time you actually drift off...
narration:18:1511429017:0.female: Maybe it's the exhaustion, but this time you actually drift off...

say:23:1511429020:0.text: H-he won't wake up, Hammie! No matter how much we call him!
say:23:1511429020:0.source_cn: 这、这是正常的吗，漫漫？主人怎么叫也叫不醒！
say:23:1511429020:0.male: H-he won't wake up, Hammie! No matter how much we call him!
say:23:1511429020:0.female: S-she won't wake up, Hammie! No matter how much we call her!

say:24:1511429021:0.text: I-I don't understand... the dream array Tasi gave us shouldn't hurt <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:24:1511429021:0.male: I-I don't understand... the dream array Tasi gave us shouldn't hurt <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:27:1511429022:0.text: Oh no, I was too late!

say:29:1511429024:0.text: After the Magister used your dream array, he fell into this deep sleep too! Why?!
say:29:1511429024:0.source_cn: 主人使用你给的入梦魔法阵之后，也昏睡过去了！为什么会这样？
say:29:1511429024:0.male: After the Magister used your dream array, he fell into this deep sleep too! Why?!
say:29:1511429024:0.female: After the Magister used your dream array, she fell into this deep sleep too! Why?!

say:30:1511429025:0.text: I know! Wait, no, listen carefully!
say:30:1511429025:0.source_cn: 我知道！哦，不对不对，我才刚刚收到消息！

say:33:1511429028:0.text: The "Tasi" Merlin met inside the dream wasn't me at all—it was a <style="highlight">foul Hypogean in disguise</style>!

say:33:1511429028:0.female: The "Tasi" Merlin met inside the dream wasn't me at all—it was a <style="highlight">foul Hypogean in disguise</style>!

say:34:1511429029:1.text: <style="highlight">The dream Merlin entered is a trap!</style>

say:34:1511429029:1.female: <style="highlight">The dream Merlin entered is a trap!</style>

say:35:1511429030:0.source_cn: 如果梦的主人无法醒来，那么梅林的意识就会永远地困在梦中...

say:35:1511429030:0.female: If the dream's host never wakes, Merlin's mind will be trapped forever!

say:36:1511429031:1.text: And if the host dies... Merlin's soul will die with him. The vilest scheme imaginable!

say:36:1511429031:1.female: And if the host dies... Merlin's soul will die with him. The vilest scheme imaginable!

say:38:1511429033:0.text: Don't worry. I'm a fairy that guards your dreams! I won't let Hypogeans corrupt them or harm Merlin.

say:38:1511429033:0.female: Don't worry. I'm a fairy that guards your dreams! I won't let Hypogeans corrupt them or harm Merlin.

say:39:1511429034:0.male: A friend warned me: to wake the dreamer, someone must enter their dream.
say:39:1511429034:0.female: A friend warned me: to wake the dreamer, someone must enter their dream.

say:40:1511429035:0.text: I'll dive into this child's dream and help Merlin. Once we find—

say:40:1511429035:0.female: I'll dive into this child's dream and help Merlin. Once we find—

say:46:1511429038:0.text: No... the Hypogean is trying to kill this child and erase Merlin's soul along with him!
say:46:1511429038:0.source_cn: 哦，不……那个恶魔肯定是想杀死这孩子，让梅林的意识也彻...
say:46:1511429038:0.male: No... the Hypogean is trying to kill this child and erase Merlin's soul along with him!
